verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports describe kitty staying fast under heavy output, such as a huge `tree` run finishing lag-free, near-zero CPU during high-speed scrolling, and good measured latency. However, no first-party doc in the pack describes its GPU rendering, and other users report slow `cat` of long files, ~300ms input lag and failures on Nvidia laptops. A dispute needs first-party claims to contradict, so this stays partial with low confidence. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the GPU-accelerated rendering pipeline, consistent independent benchmarks under heavy output, resolution of contrary reports of slow long-file output and input lag.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on GPU-accelerated rendering that stays fast and responsive under heavy output

citations.quote: kitty finishes in a fraction of a second, lag-free
macOS Activity Monitor shows almost zero usage even during high-speed scrolling
kitty is much better than the rest on latency
